issue_title: Unrealistic Disease Prevalence

DM prevalence now comes only from primary cohort assignment and probabilistic comorbidity rolls (expected ~42% → reduced significantly).

issue_title: Missing Lipid Monitoring in Diabetics
fix_summary: Added forced lipid panel at first outpatient encounter + every 4th thereafter for all DM patients (ADA annual lipid monitoring guideline). Previously DM patients only had A1c, BMP, uACR, and eGFR forced — lipid panels were only forced for HTN/CVD/preventive cohorts.

issue_title: T2DM prevalence inflated by misplaced E11.9 in hypertension cohort diagnoses
fix_summary: Removed E11.9 from hypertension cohort diagnoses[] list — it was being applied to 100% of HTN patients unconditionally. The comorbidities[] entry (prevalence_pct=0.35) already handles probabilistic DM assignment correctly. This fix also removed the generator auto-add block from an earlier session that was similarly inflating DM prevalence.

issue_title: High prevalence of Type 2 Diabetes
fix_summary: Reduced DM comorbidity prevalences to realistic Florida rates: preventive_wellness 0.35→0.10 (~11% general pop), hypertension 0.35→0.30 (real-world 25-35%), copd 0.35→0.15, tick_borne 0.10→0.05. Expected overall DM prevalence ~22%.

issue_title: Pediatric patient with adult medications (root cause)
fix_summary: _has_htn_diag was checking cohort template (diagnoses+comorbidities) instead of patient's actual diag_list. This caused every patient in any cohort with I10 as a comorbidity to receive antihypertensive dose-escalation medications, regardless of whether they actually rolled the comorbidity. Fixed to check diag_list.

issue_title: Implausible lab values (glucose 700)
fix_summary: Reduced hyperglycemic encounter glucose range from 400-700 to 350-500 mg/dL (still severe hyperglycemia, but not DKA-level extreme). Updated LAB004 ceiling from 800 to 600.

issue_title: Missing lipid monitoring in DM patients (COPD/tick-borne cohorts)
fix_summary: Added lipid panel definition to COPD and tick-borne cohorts. These cohorts had no lipid panel defined so _lipid_panel_1 was None and the forced ADA annual lipid monitoring code had no panel to schedule. 43 DM patients from these cohorts were affected.

issue_title: Young wellness patient on adult chronic disease medications
fix_summary: Raised min_age from 18 to 35 for E11.9 and I10 comorbidities in preventive_wellness cohort. T2DM and essential hypertension onset before 35 in a wellness population is unrealistic. This prevents 18-30 year old wellness patients from being assigned DM/HTN diagnoses and their associated medications.

issue_title: Implausible glucose max value

issue_title: Medications prescribed without matching diagnosis
fix_summary: Added for_diagnosis_code filter to medication assignment. Previously generator sampled 60-100% of the cohort medication list regardless of patient diagnoses, causing Metformin/Lisinopril/Atorvastatin to be prescribed to wellness patients with no DM or HTN. Now a medication with for_diagnosis_code is only assigned if the patient has a diagnosis code starting with that prefix.

issue_title: Young patients getting adult meds via comorbidity gaps
fix_summary: Raised min_age to 30 for I10 (HTN) comorbidity in tick_borne, asthma, copd, and diabetes_t2 cohorts. Raised min_age to 35 for E78.5 (hyperlipidemia) in preventive_wellness. This eliminates all chronic disease medications for patients under 25. Combined with the for_diagnosis_code gate this reduces young-patient medication violations from 111 to 0.

issue_title: Inconsistent lab result flags (HbA1c 6.4 flagged H vs range 4.0-6.4)
fix_summary: HbA1c normal_max corrected from 6.4 to 5.6 (ADA clinical cutoff). Generator marks >=5.7 as H; normal_max=5.6 means 5.7 > 5.6 → H is consistent. Previously 6.4 == normal_max so 6.4 > 6.4 was False → expected N but got H.

issue_title: Missing lipid panel in CKD cohort
fix_summary: Added lipid panel to CKD cohort (weight=0.25, abnormal_pct=0.55). KDIGO guidelines require annual lipid monitoring for CKD patients.

issue_title: Age-inappropriate medication (Metformin, patient aged 15)
fix_summary: Extended _is_false_positive with pediatric medication approval list. Metformin is FDA-approved for T2DM from age 10+. Filter now catches age-inappropriate flags for medications with known pediatric approvals at the cited age.

issue_title: Missing SGLT2 or ARB for CKD + diabetes patient (Patient 377)
fix_summary: Added Empagliflozin 10 MG (weight=0.15) to CKD cohort and Empagliflozin 10 MG (weight=0.30) to diabetes_t2 cohort. KDIGO 2020/ADA 2024 Class 1A recommendation for eGFR>=20 + T2DM.

issue_title: Missing lipid-lowering therapy (Patient 203 has Atorvastatin but LLM ignored it)
fix_summary: Updated _filter_false_positives to accept output_dir and load medications.csv; CSV-backed check verifies patient actually lacks a statin before allowing the issue to pass through.

issue_title: Implausible HDL 20.0 mg/dL (filter failing due to patient ID in evidence)
fix_summary: Fixed _is_false_positive physiologic range filter: strip 'Patient NNN' from evidence before number extraction so patient IDs don't contaminate the candidate list for lab value checks.

issue_title: ACE inhibitor patient flagged for missing ARB (ACE-I is equivalent)
fix_summary: Added false positive rule: if ACE inhibitor (lisinopril/ramipril/etc.) is present in evidence and issue mentions missing ARB or SGLT2, the ARB arm is already satisfied. Added system prompt note clarifying ACE-I = ARB for RAAS blockade.

overall_assessment: The dataset is mostly clinically accurate, but there are a few critical issues related to age-inappropriate medication use and missing expected clinical associations.

issue_title: Pregnancy prevalence 46.8% vs target 14% (sdoh_risk O80 false trigger)
fix_summary: Removed O80 from sdoh_risk diagnoses list — O80 caused _is_pregnancy_cohort=True for all 25%-weight sdoh_risk patients, inflating pregnancy prevalence.

issue_title: GDM prevalence 36% vs target 9% (O24.419 in diagnoses for all pregnancy patients)
fix_summary: Removed O24.419 from pregnancy diagnoses list (was secondary for 100% of patients); kept in comorbidities with prevalence_pct corrected to 0.09 (was 0.10).

issue_title: Preeclampsia=0 (O14.00 in primary diagnoses — overridden by pregnancy context, never rendered)
fix_summary: Removed O14.00 from pregnancy diagnoses list (is_primary:true meant it was never secondary, and enc_primary was overridden by pregnancy context). O14.00 stays in comorbidities at 5%. Added prenatal_dx_override:{O14:{code:O14.00}} so 5% of pregnancy patients get O14.00 as prenatal primary.

issue_title: C-section rate=0 (O82 in primary diagnoses — overridden by pregnancy context)
fix_summary: Removed O82 from pregnancy diagnoses list; added O82 to comorbidities at prevalence_pct=0.30. Added delivery_dx_override:{O82:{code:O82}} so 30% of pregnancy patients get O82 as delivery primary instead of O80.

issue_title: Multi-facility 16% vs target 35% (pregnancy cohort hardcoded single-facility)
fix_summary: Removed is_pregnancy_cohort from the multi-facility shortcircuit at line 393 so pregnancy patients follow the normal distribution-based facility assignment.

issue_title: Postpartum encounters only 17-23% (42-day window shorter than 58-day median encounter gap)
fix_summary: Extended postpartum_end window from 42 to 84 days (12-week fourth-trimester standard) in _plan_pregnancy_episodes. With 58-day median gap to next encounter, 97.6% of delivery patients will have at least one encounter in the 84-day window vs 11.9% in the 42-day window.

issue_title: Fallback CSV loop uses alphabetically-first diagnosis code instead of pregnancy-context primary
fix_summary: Cohorts without document_templates (pregnancy cohort) use the fallback CSV path that picked _all_dx_r[0] (alphabetically sorted), causing O34.21 as primary for delivery encounters instead of O80/O82. Fixed to use _enc_primary_dx (precomputed pregnancy-context-aware primary from the diagnosis loop).
